newsitem.title: HONG KONG: UDL Holdings mulls Kenworth unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: UDL Holdings mulls Kenworth unit spinoff.

text.p: Civil and marine engineering concern UDL Holdings Ltd said it is pursuing the possibility of a separate listing for its mechanical engineering unit UDL Kenworth Engineering Ltd on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

"The proposed separate listing will give UDL Kenworth access to the capital market to raise funds for the continued expansion of its electrical and mechanical engineering business," said UDL Holdings's chairman Leung Yat Tung in a statement.
It will allow UDL group to utilize its available resources to concentrate on the future development of its own businesses, Leung added.

The company said "an advance booking form relating to the proposed separate listing has been submitted to the stock exchange for initial review. However, the timing of the proposed separate listing is yet to be determined."
UDL Holdings's indirectly wholly-owned UDL Kenworth is engaging in supply, installation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical engineering services.
